item.name: Retrieves user information within the Proompty API system. By sending a GET request to this endpoint, users can obtain detailed data pertaining to their profile and associated claims. This includes essential user attributes such as email, full name, avatar URL, subscription plan, and role. Additionally, the response includes claims regarding the user's subscription status, role type, and other pertinent details. In the event that the requested user is not found, a 404 error response is returned, indicating the absence of the specified user within the system.

description.content:
Proompty is an advanced Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) API designed
to empower users in seamlessly integrating their data and harnessing the
power of customized Large Language Model (LLM) prompts for interactive
communication. At its core, Proompty operates through a series of
interconnected functionalities that enable users to navigate and
manipulate their data effectively.
